reviewScope: Supplementary classification of the 26 technical lexical candidates in the shared UI theme runtime. The four literal fragments contributing to the aria-label and title templates were mapped to existing semantic entries in arc13-classified-ui-js-batch-2026-10-24.json; the mode names (Automático/Claro/Escuro/Auto) are also captured there but omitted from the whitespace-based heuristic inventory.
limitations: Inventory only; runtime and locale resources remain unchanged.
The source has user-facing literals not captured by the heuristic because they are single-word values. Existing semantic UI entries are the source for those strings.

notes: Technical selector, attribute, enum, style value or DOM markup; user-facing mode names and accessible/title templates are classified in the shared UI theme batch.
